topic: Debugging impression and dwell time discrepancies
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused heavily on debugging data discrepancies across multiple analytics reports and platforms. Initial issues included incorrect impression coefficients (0.4 vs 0.3) in the script, which were corrected by someone.

Later discussions involved reconciling total traffic figures: one instance noted a discrepancy between the summary page total and the Location Traffic sum, attributed to duplicate frame data from a single cluster. Another issue was identified regarding missing dwell time data for a specific cluster (42608), despite historical data existing in January.

Finally, updates were made on forecasting models, including fixing division by zero errors and preparing new forecasts.
decisions: The impression coefficient used in the script was corrected from 0.4 to 0.3.
A fix for missing dwell time data (cluster 42608) was implemented on staging.
New forecast models were prepared and updated.
action_items: Verify the accuracy of total traffic figures across different report sections, accounting for potential frame duplication.
